adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is declared as `z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), ... })`. The computed key expression `z.string().toString()` is evaluated immediately and becomes a literal property name (very likely `"[object Object]"`), making that numeric field *required* under that exact key. Real OAuth refresh responses will have fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date`, not a key named `"[object Object]"`, so `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` will fail when sync is enabled, causing `parseRefreshTokenResponse` to throw `Invalid refreshed tokens were returned`. Additionally, `z.object(...)` will strip unknown keys by default, contradicting the comment about allowing other properties unless `.passthrough()` is used (though the required-literal-key issue alone already breaks behavior).
